subject: Physical Education
notes: OCR GCSE (9-1) Physical Education J587. Topics and subtopics already exist (remapped from AQA 8582 by migration pe_ocr_j587_remap); this file only adds gap-fill questions to them, so everything is existing: true. Use J587 terms: SMART = Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Recorded, Timed; skill continua are simple-complex and open-closed only; drugs are anabolic steroids, beta blockers and stimulants; axes are frontal, transverse and longitudinal.
